text: Split a big bedroom to make an office.
Three years later you retire, stop needing the office, and open the bedroom back up.
Four bedrooms, living room, den, office, two bathrooms, kitchen, dining area.
We have all the allotments of a domicile.
But the way we need that space has changed.
I was gone for six years.
Three people becomes four, and eventually that same house could be too much for one person.
A dome with movable, nonstructural partitions gives us a way to reallocate the space.
